services.name: Gray Whales
services.desc: Orca whales are guaranteed on our full-day whale watching tours! With 6-7 hours, experience a full day on the water, a greater search range, and more time watching whales. If your goal is to see orcas, this is the tour for you. If you don't see orcas on the full day tour, you get to come again for free on another full-day whale watch or any of our 3-4 hour signature whale watches. Join us on the most comfortable boat in the Salish Sea! With three different viewing decks and two different indoor heated cabins, there’s triple the square footage per person than any other boat in the area! blurb: Guests board the Island Explorer 5, a state-of-the-art 100-foot catamaran designed for whale watching, departing from Anacortes. Tours range from 3 to 12 hours, offering opportunities to see orcas, humpbacks, minkes, and gray whales. The company guarantees whale sightings with a 97% success rate and offers a variety of tour lengths and private charters.
